claim: Patchline ships a reference enterprise deployment serving a real multi-team org with published SLOs for a quarter. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the published SLOs claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make enterprise-reference-deployment-gate`.
